The Ministry of Health today received a delegation from Zeyla Furniture LLC, led by its Chief Executive Officer, Halit Sirkan Hatay, on a courtesy visit facilitated by The Gambia’s Ambassador to Nigeria, H.E. Mohamadou Musa Njie.

The meeting provided an opportunity for the delegation to present the company’s expertise and explore potential areas of collaboration to strengthen The Gambia’s healthcare infrastructure.

Discussions focused on hospital construction and equipping, the supply of medical equipment and furniture, project financing, and infrastructure development.

The engagement forms part of efforts to explore potential partnerships and investment opportunities aligned with the country’s healthcare priorities and the broader goal of improving healthcare infrastructure and service delivery.
